title: Choose the look for your Wishlist
question: The roll assigned Index-Tab Stationery. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Index-Tab Stationery
options.lineage: Kokuyo Campus notebooks and colored binder dividers
options.thesis: Your wishlist as a well-kept binder: every category a saturated index tab, every item clean on bright white paper.
options.viewport: Cobalt header with the dollar total set large in a classic serif; colored category tabs sit on top of the item list, each showing its subtotal; the savings plan is a side column.
options.risk: If the tab colors are used timidly it collapses into a generic white dashboard.

raised.raise: Prices sit in fixed tabular columns that never shift from row to row.
Every product photo sits at the same scale on an identical white plate.
Each month of the savings plan is a fixed-capacity slot that items fill in order.
Remove sits apart from Buy and Edit, never one slip away.

options.label: Electronics-Store Price Card
options.lineage: Bic Camera and Yodobashi in-store price cards
options.thesis: Every item gets the bright price card a Tokyo electronics store would hang under it.
options.viewport: A grid of product cards, each with a yellow price card showing the yen or yuan price in big red numerals and the dollar price beneath.
options.risk: The most familiar choice for this subject; loud red and yellow can tire the eye over a long list.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.lineage: zoo and gardens fold-out guide maps
options.thesis: Flat, unshaded color fields for each category, with bright capsule buttons, on a light ground.
materials: classic serif in place of the map's grotesk
options.viewport: Each category is a large rounded color field holding its items; the total sits on a yellow capsule.
options.case: Matches light and saturated perfectly, but big color fields slow down scanning a long list.
options.risk: Can read as playful rather than as a tool for money.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Prices flip character by character on a black board.
options.viewport: Items as board rows with flipping prices.
options.case: Dark, which contradicts the light theme you asked for.
options.kept: Fixed price columns that never move.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Items as engraved plates on cream paper.
options.viewport: Plates in a row, one per item.
options.case: Cream and sepia are muted, not saturated.
options.kept: Every photo at one fixed scale on an identical plate.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.thesis: Your list as a hand-ruled tracklist.
options.viewport: Side A and side B tracklists.
options.kept: Fixed capacity per side: each month is a slot items fill.

options.label: Developer Console
options.case: Dark, which contradicts the light theme you asked for.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size, rank by weight and case.
options.case: The tilted layout makes prices harder to scan.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white shopping-list table with one blue accent, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Header, a sortable item table, totals and plan below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other price tracker.
